decisions.statement: Every kind of file names the operations a run of that kind is expected to do.
An operation that returns is synced.
An operation that throws is an upload failure with the error thrown.
A throw is caught rather than reaching the caller.
A chain halts at the first operation that is not synced.
Every operation after the halt is recorded as skipped.
A side file the caller named no path for is written without being observed.
A side file whose addon folder is absent is recorded as skipped.
A side file export is asked for no path where the addon folder is absent.
Every operation has the moment the operation ran.

definition: how each thing the watcher tries is watched and turned into a sync operation
